title: Wish for Automation
symptom: The user wants to use automation to temporarily increase basal rate by 20% and then reset it, but the cancellation rule requires selecting a defined basal rate, which is inconvenient. They wish for selection of defined basal rate in automation rule and integration of cancellation rule into the actual automation.
evidence_quote: I would like the following: a) Selection of the defined BR in the automation rule (not just% rate = ...) b) Integration of the cancellation rule into the actual automation
